About Me

I moved into performance marketing through practical execution, not only theory.

I build websites, landing pages, lead capture systems, and marketing automation workflows while learning and applying Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, GTM, WordPress, HubSpot CRM, and SEO fundamentals.

My portfolio includes 11 live websites and landing pages across real estate, emergency services, education, e-commerce, local services, and packers & movers. I also created 5 ICP frameworks and 1000+ Meta ad creatives in 1:1, 9:16, and 16:9 formats.

My focus is to help businesses generate leads, track user actions, and improve campaign performance through landing pages, analytics, and automation systems.
